name: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde

text: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde is a scenario for Arkham Horror: The Card Game based on the classic story by Robert Louis Stevenson. This scenario can be played as a standalone scenario, or as a side-story during any campaign.
This scenario would not have been possible without the amazing design framework created by Matt Newman, Nate French and everyone involved in Arkham Horror: The Card Game at FFG.

notes: This scenario is an unofficial fan creation and in no way endorsed by Fantasy Flight Games. All rights to artwork belong to the relevant artists.
